title: Organization member list, org-authority/1 (DEC-0129)
description: One organization's signed list of admitted members, the source of its relay's admission set (DEC-0047, CT-37): each member by the subject pairwise to the relay, a role, the issuer of its context's tokens and the #sig keys of its enrollments in the organization. An organization server drafts it (Fabric ADR-0178 point 3); an administrator's signing passkey, certified by the organization's root in org-key-set/1's administrators, signs it in Fabric or a pinned page, never a server (point 2). Valid for at most 7 days (FAC-SEM-150). The digest is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 of this document without digest and signature; the signature is a WebAuthn assertion over the register's org-authority/1 challenge. docs/specification/membership.md.

issuer.description: The organization server that drafted the list, as the organization's key set names it.

revision.description: Rises with every list an administrator signs; a reader refuses a lower revision than the one it applied, and the same revision with other bytes.

expiresAt.description: After issuedAt and at most 7 days after it (v4 §7, the organization's records; FAC-SEM-150). Past it the relay admits nobody from this list.

members.description: The admitted members: each subject, each iss and each kid once across the list (FAC-SEM-150).

digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 form of this document without digest and signature (DEC-0043).

signature.description: An administrator's passkey assertion over the register's org-authority/1 challenge, derived from digest (DEC-0063).

subject.description: The member, as org-membership/1 names it to the relay's audience: pairwise and opaque, never an email, a name, the estate id or a device id.

role.description: The role, as org-membership/1 maps it. The relay admits every role alike; a role grants nothing at the relay.

iss.description: The issuer of the member's tokens in this organization's context, as the member's estate pins it (DEC-0128): opaque, never containing an estate id.

keys.description: The #sig keys of the member's enrollments in this organization (DEC-0128 UE-1: each enrollment its own id), the keys a relay session authenticates with.

publicKey.description: The enrollment's P-256 signing key, as its device enrollment carries it: the relay verifies ES256 only (DEC-0047).
